title: LexisNexis Contract Addendum - Local PD Data Sharing

communications.subject: Maryland Public Information Act Request: LexisNexis Contract Addendum - Local PD Data Sharing
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Maryland Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. The LexisNexis XML Addendum, sometimes called the "AVCC XML Addendum" or similar. To aid in locating the file, I'll note that it contains the searchable term "PSDEX" and is typically 2-3 pages. This document dictates who LexisNexis is able to share Takoma PD's RMS and CAD/CFS data with. 

If the addendum is attached to a full contract and Schedule A, please include those as well. Timeframe: 2018 - Present. 

2. Any data sharing agreement or contract with SoundThinking or ShotSpotter. I am interested in CopLinkX or CrimeTracer data. If you have ShotSpotter solely for gunshot detection, we do not need those files. Timeframe: 2020 - Present

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal
